name: Masaryk University
summary: Public university in Brno with 11 English-taught bachelor's across five faculties, plus General Medicine, Dentistry and Pharmacy.

handoff.label: English-taught programmes by faculty and level

ib.text: Masaryk accepts the IB Diploma directly as proof of secondary education, with no nostrification. Each programme sets its own test, interview or documents; several waive English for IB students.

apply.via: MU e-application, one per programme and fee

dates.label: Social Studies applications open for autumn 2027

programmes.name: Biology and Biochemistry
programmes.about: Biology and biochemistry taught together: cell and molecular biology, genetics, microbiology, physiology and chemistry, with lab courses and a bachelor's thesis inside a research group.
programmes.ib: Online test and online interview in biology and biochemistry; no fixed English level, upload your best proof.
programmes.selectionNote: Online test of 12 open questions, then an online interview on the subject, your letter and English; 350 of 500 needed at each stage. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Data Analytics
programmes.about: Mathematical foundations of data analysis with practical data skills, built with industry partners. Taught in combined (part-time) mode and run fully online, so you need not live in Brno.
programmes.ib: Entry Trial Test of maths and logic problems (75 of 100 to pass); English B2 recommended.
programmes.selectionNote: One round: the Entry Trial Test at the faculty in Brno (online only in exceptional cases); a CV and motivation letter are mandatory. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Culture, Media and Performative Arts
programmes.about: Film, theatre, new media and culture studied as industries and practices, mixing film and theatre studies, media studies and cultural anthropology, with internships at Czech festivals and media.
programmes.ib: No English certificate if you attended an IB Diploma school for two years or more.
programmes.selectionNote: A statement of purpose and a 1,000-word essay from your own observations and interviews are scored; shortlisted applicants have an online interview.

programmes.name: English Language and Literature
programmes.about: English philology in four strands: language skills, linguistics, literary studies and cultural studies of the UK, US, Canada and Australia, ending with a thesis and a state exam.
programmes.ib: No English certificate if you attended an IB Diploma school for two years or more.
programmes.selectionNote: Statement of purpose, a teacher's recommendation and your English are scored; shortlisted applicants have a 15–20 minute online interview in English.

separateFrom.name: English Language for Education
separateFrom.reason: Different faculties and admissions: this is English philology at the Faculty of Arts (documents, then an interview); the other trains English teachers at the Faculty of Education.

programmes.name: Education for Diversity and Inclusion
programmes.about: Education and psychology, social education, and special and inclusive education for future educators, social workers and facilitators, with community work and a one-semester internship.
programmes.ib: Online interview; English at B1 (no certificate needed if your school taught in English).
programmes.selectionNote: A 10–15 minute online interview on motivation and diversity in education, scored out of 20; 12 needed. Up to 70 admitted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: English Language for Education
programmes.about: English language, literature and culture for future English teachers, with compulsory teaching practice in real schools already in the bachelor's.
programmes.ib: English B2 certificate (IELTS 5.5, TOEFL 72 or Duolingo 90), or a school letter that you were taught in English.
programmes.selectionNote: A 10–15 minute online interview on your English and motivation to teach, scored out of 20; 12 needed. Up to 70 admitted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

separateFrom.name: English Language and Literature
separateFrom.reason: A teacher-training degree at the Faculty of Education with its own interview and deadline; the other is English philology at the Faculty of Arts.

programmes.name: Business Management and Finance
programmes.about: Management, finance, marketing and economics for a career in business, banking or consulting, with a choice to specialise in finance or management.
programmes.ib: Predicted grades don't count: take a Scio test (50th percentile) or the SAT (1050). English: IB English A or B HL at 6, or a test.
programmes.selectionNote: A final IB Diploma (28 points, Maths 4) counts only if you hold it by the deadline; otherwise a Scio GAP, OSP or Maths test. Plus a 2-minute motivation video.

programmes.name: Economics and Public Policy
programmes.about: Economics, public policy and public administration: how governments and the public sector decide, for careers in administration, international organisations, NGOs or policy work.
programmes.ib: Predicted grades don't count: take a Scio test (50th percentile) or the SAT (1050). English: IB English A or B HL at 6, or a test.
programmes.selectionNote: A final IB Diploma (28 points, Maths 4) counts only if you hold it by the deadline; otherwise a Scio GAP, OSP or Maths test. Plus a 2-minute motivation video.

programmes.name: Global Challenges: Society, Politics, Environment
programmes.about: Political, social and environmental global challenges studied across political science, environmental studies, social anthropology and sociology, with training in research methods.
programmes.ib: Online Scio GAP test, 30th percentile minimum; IB students need no English certificate.
programmes.selectionNote: Register and pay separately for Scio's online General Academic Prerequisites test and let Scio send your best result; the 30th percentile is the pass mark.

programmes.name: International Relations and European Politics
programmes.about: International relations and European politics: theories of conflict and cooperation, European integration and international political economy, with a strong thread of research methods.
programmes.ib: Documents then an online interview; IB students need no English certificate.
programmes.selectionNote: Round 1 scores your cover letter, transcript and English (30 of 40 to go on); round 2 is an online interview, also 30 of 40 to be admitted.

programmes.name: Politics, Media, and Communication
programmes.about: How politics, the media and society shape each other, combining comparative politics, political theory and political behaviour with new media and mass communication research.
programmes.ib: Online Scio GAP test, 30th percentile minimum; IB students need no English certificate.
programmes.selectionNote: Register and pay separately for Scio's online General Academic Prerequisites test and let Scio send your best result; the 30th percentile is the pass mark.

programmes.name: General Medicine
programmes.about: Six-year medical degree: two years of sciences, anatomy and physiology, then clinical rotations; Czech is taught in years 1–4 so you can talk to patients.
programmes.ib: Tests in biology, chemistry and physics (60% to pass), or no test with 35 IB points incl. 19 from HL Bio, HL Chem and Physics.
programmes.selectionNote: Three 40-question tests; highest scores first. From Denmark you sit it via Interstudium in Oslo; EU citizens also get June and July dates. The waiver needs final grades.

lastYear.text: 2 Jan–31 July; exam via a representative

programmes.name: Dentistry
programmes.about: Five-year dental degree moving from theory through preclinical to clinical subjects, in a credit system that allows part of the study at European partner universities.
programmes.ib: Tests in biology, chemistry and physics, 65% to pass; no IB waiver for Dentistry.
programmes.selectionNote: Three 40-question tests; highest scores first. From Denmark you sit it via Interstudium in Oslo; EU citizens also get June and July dates.

lastYear.text: 2 Jan–31 July; exam via a representative

programmes.name: Pharmacy
programmes.about: Five-year integrated pharmacy degree covering drug preparation, pharmacology and pharmacotherapy, and pharmacy law and ethics, with a six-month internship; over half the classes are practical.
programmes.ib: Online biology and chemistry test (40 of 80), or none with 30 IB points incl. 11 from HL Bio and HL Chem; IB exempts from English.
programmes.selectionNote: Pick an online test date in the e-application; results within two working days. Up to 60 admitted. Waiver from the 2026/27 terms; 2027 not yet published.

notes: The Faculty of Medicine still lists a CZK 990 recognition fee before enrolment; Economics, Arts and Pharmacy charge IB holders no verification fee.
Each faculty runs its own admission and fee (CZK 800–870 per application); apply to each programme separately in the MU e-application.
Economics does not accept predicted grades as proof of academic ability, so book a Scio test or the SAT in good time.
